fusions.name: Bobbin Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 shafts of stiffened thread at once, each dealing 4 damage. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Taut Line
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt trailing a taut line at an enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Restrung
fusions.desc: Restrings your weapon with longer thread: for 20 seconds, your attack and spell range is multiplied by 1.4.

fusions.name: Silk-Wound String
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
